tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background: paper by day, night by night. Text tokens are checked against it.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Sidebars, code blocks, table headers.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, popovers, inputs.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and rules only (1.3:1 / 1.5:1); never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders and focus rings: at least 3.2:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text, headings, the wordmark. 15.5:1 / 16.4:1 on surface-100.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: captions, metadata, taglines. 6.5:1 / 8.7:1.

tokens.name: moon
tokens.usage: Brand colour, close to Lua's navy: the moon of the mark, navigation, headings accents, large brand fields. 12.4:1 / 11.7:1.

tokens.name: moonlight
tokens.usage: The lit crescent of the moon and soft brand tints. Decorative: never text.

tokens.name: earth
tokens.usage: Verdigris accent, the earth of the mark: links, primary actions, active states. Usable as text at any size: 5.3:1 / 7.1:1.

tokens.name: on-earth
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an earth fill: 5.9:1 / 7.1:1.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Passing tests, valid contracts. 5.7:1 / 9.5:1. Always with a label or icon, since it sits near earth in hue.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, breaking changes, failed checks. 6.8:1 / 8.4:1.

families.serif: "STIX Two Text", "STIX Two", Cambria, Georgia, serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero titles and the wordmark, set in all small caps (font-variant-caps: all-small-caps).

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: Page titles, numbered like sections of a paper (3.2 Refinement types).

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Running text of guides and reference pages; italics for defined terms.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Navigation, buttons, tabs, tables of parameters.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon gaps, inline padding of badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside controls.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, paragraph spacing.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gaps between blocks.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section spacing, hero padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inline code, badges, inputs: almost square, like print.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, code blocks.
